devdoc.details: `getMinRate()` is view-only and returns 0 (disabled) if the tuple is unconfigured, the adapter fails,      or the adapter's data is stale. Rate semantics: - All rates returned are in preciseUnits (1e18). - Rates represent "fiat per deposit token".

createRateManager((address,address,uint2.details: The identifier is derived as keccak256(abi.encodePacked(address(this), nextId)).      This ties IDs to the registry deployment and avoids deliberate collisions.      Reverts if inputs are invalid or fee exceeds caps.

params._config: Rate manager configuration {manager, feeRecipient, maxFee, fee, depositHook, name, uri}.

getMinRate(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32).details: Returns 0 if the tuple is not configured, the oracle returns invalid data, or the data is stale.      For constant-rate adapter configs (e.g. Chainlink `feed == address(0)`), returns (1 + spread) in preciseUnits.

removeOracleConfig(bytes32,bytes32,bytes.details: Only callable by the rate manager. After removal, `getMinRate()` returns 0 for the tuple.

setFee(bytes32,uint256).details: Only callable by config.manager. New fee must be <= maxFee and if > 0 then feeRecipient must be set.

setOracleConfig(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32,.details: Only callable by the rate manager. The adapter is responsible for validating and normalizing      `_rawAdapterConfig` (e.g. Chainlink adapter supports `feed == address(0)` as a constant 1.0 base rate      which can be used for USD when the deposit token is assumed to be USDC).

setRateManagerConfig(bytes32,address,add.details: Only callable by the current config.manager. Does not alter maxFee.      If an existing fee is non-zero, a non-zero feeRecipient must be supplied.

devdoc.title: OracleRateManagerRegistry

createRateManager((address,address,uint2.notice: Creates a new rate manager configuration.

getDepositHook(bytes32).notice: Returns the deposit hook address configured for a manager id (or address(0) if none).

getFeeAndRecipient(bytes32).notice: Returns the manager fee and recipient for an id.

getMinRate(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32).notice: Returns the manager-level minimum rate for a (paymentMethod, currency) pair.

getOracleConfig(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32).notice: Returns the oracle configuration for a tuple.

getRateManager(bytes32).notice: Returns the full manager configuration for an id.

isRateManager(bytes32).notice: Returns true if the manager id exists.

removeOracleConfig(bytes32,bytes32,bytes.notice: Removes oracle config for a (rateManagerId, paymentMethod, currency) tuple.

setFee(bytes32,uint256).notice: Updates the manager fee for a given id.

setOracleConfig(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32,.notice: Configures an oracle feed + spread for a (rateManagerId, paymentMethod, currency) tuple.

setRateManagerConfig(bytes32,address,add.notice: Updates mutable fields on a rate manager config.

userdoc.notice: Permissionless registry of “deposit rate managers” backed by onchain oracles.
